title: Alarchin Bridge / Rehabilitation
summary: Major rehabilitation design for a protected bridge crossing the Griboyedov Canal in Saint Petersburg.
methods: Finite-element analysis · rehabilitation design · steel / concrete · drawings
challenge: Develop a rehabilitation scheme for an existing heritage bridge while addressing structural performance, site constraints and conservation requirements.
approach: Developed structural models, examined the existing bridge configuration and designed rehabilitation interventions. Prepared calculation and drawing documentation.
outcome: Graduate qualification work defended with Excellent (A). The bridge also serves as a case study in lifecycle-management research.

title: Excavation / PLAXIS Analysis
